name: Gan Tian
major: Multimedia Information Processing, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Multimodal Large Models

papers: Social Debiasing for Fair Multi-modal LLMs
Generative Agents for Multimodal Controversy Detection
Enhancing Democratic Mediation through Norm-Awareness in Generative Agent Societies
paper_description: Introduces a Counterfactual dataset with Multiple Social Concepts (CMSC) and an Anti-Stereotype Debiasing strategy (ASD) to reduce social biases in Multi-modal Large Language Models.
Proposes AgentMCD, an Agent-based Multimodal Controversy Detection architecture using LLMs as generative agents for multi-aspect reasoning and simulation to improve explainability.
Proposes ComPaSC3, a model for Community Level Information Pathway Prediction (CLIPP) that uses LLMs to interpret social context and address the cold start problem in niche communities.
Focuses on enhancing democratic mediation through norm-awareness in societies of generative agents.
